moved_promises.description: A human trial of two Regeneron muscle-enhancing antibodies combined with semaglutide was due to begin later in 2024.
moved_promises.reason: Atlantic attributes the planned human trial to the two Regeneron antibodies with semaglutide, not bimagrumab.

scope.arms: Four combination arms contain both drugs. Obesity is included; summary identifies the wider trial population and diabetes exclusion.
scope.limits: Less lean-mass loss does not mean no lean-mass loss or proven strength benefit.

scope.arms: D0 and D1: all three drugs together during the 26-week weight-loss phase.
scope.limits: June 2025 interim efficacy analysis excluded data after discontinuation; higher severe adverse-event and discontinuation rates prevent a benefit-only summary.

scope.arms: B0/B1/C0/C1 in Part B; arms 2/3 in Part C. Garetosmab is not an active component.
scope.limits: October 2026 lower-dose results concern 52-week lean-mass preservation, without meaningful additional weight loss. Phase 2, not an approved combination.

statement_corrections.2529: Misstates 50.8/51.3% relative lean-mass preservation as percentages of weight loss from fat. Rejected; original text and scores retained.
statement_corrections.2530: Two-drug result does not belong on the narrowed three-drug card.
statement_corrections.2531: 80.9% wording fails to specify preservation relative to semaglutide-associated loss, not 80.9% of baseline lean mass. Rejected.
statement_corrections.2534: Generic with-or-without mechanism does not define the three-drug regimen.
statement_corrections.2282,2283: Monotherapy findings are not findings for the combination.

promise_correction.verification: Atlantic links the January 8 2024 Regeneron presentation, slides 20–21, naming trevogrumab, garetosmab and semaglutide and the planned mid-2024 Phase 2 trial. Only claim/source foreign keys changed; the promise was neither deleted nor rewritten.

paper_exclusion_reason: These concern semaglutide without the complete three-drug regimen (including STEP 1 and STEP 4), not COURAGE.
